author: THE_FUSA
body: This way, donors don't have to go against weak-classed noobs. eg; donor has barbarian, leather armor diamond sword. nondonors hve warrior, leather armor, stone sword, to avoid unfair matchups like this, make a separate server for donors. I think this will help balance the classes.
